title: TAVAE: A VAE with Adaptable Priors Explains Contextual Modulation in the Visual Cortex

layout.note: Eight lettered panels with no frames: the top row holds the rig picture over the stimulus strip (a over b), the recorded heat map (c) and the response profile (d); the bottom row holds the VAE and TAVAE cartoon (e), the latent posterior map (f), the task prior (g) and the model response profile (h).

lesson: Put experiment panels (setup, stimuli, recorded map and profile) over model panels (cartoon, latent picture, prior, simulated profile) and give the recorded and the simulated profile the same axes and colours so the match is checked by eye. Draw baseline and proposed model as two rows of the same trapezoids, keeping the colour of the unchanged block and nesting the old block inside the new.
